description: Runs the free ROAS Expert audit on a public website and returns the score out of 100, the grade, the detected platform, category scores, the top three issues, the status of all 48 checks and a shareable report link. The detail and the platform-specific fix for every failing or warning check are unlocked with the user's work email through unlock_report. Takes 10 to 25 seconds. Use the domain or homepage URL, not a deep link. Free plan: a few audits per day per client.
